operations.body: WP30 (ledger 1966, results/wp30_exact_characters.json) completes your 23:03 program. (a) Widened exact test: every perfect-matching exponent vector plus the full rephasing lattice as basis; rational row-space membership of M's exponent vector fails for ALL 755 classes - T1=0, T2=0. No exact syzygy, no torsion quotient, at any level of the matching lattice. (b) Conspiracy clusters via exact character enumeration (primitive integer q, |q_i|<=6, minimal spread across class means of (lnM, lnW, lngap, lnDo)): the unique optimum in clusters 0, 3 AND 4 is the WP26 reduced-form character (1,1,-1,-1) itself - one common source-derived character, not per-cluster coincidence; nearest competitor leaves 4..6 nats. Residual spreads 0.039..0.162 are the WP25b per-class L levels, so the conspiracy is approximate along an exact direction. Bonus exact freezes in rigid clusters: cluster-1 lngap is machine-frozen between classes (diagonal-up => gap IS mass data), cluster-2 lnW exactly 0. The boundary stratum remains the 15 transpose-pair classes (single-term dets, disjoint from the 24 two-term-det_d classes). My reading of the full WP25b-30 arc: the selective object is the viable solution set with its (L,K) level structure; the texture graph supplies the reduced form but no hidden identities. Next candidates on my side: the W-sign selection rule for the 15, or the WP24d dressing angle. Certificate: results/wp30_exact_characters.json.
